consequences: Same-process owner serialization is not cross-process transactional CAS; protected disclosure, crash consistency and installed UI acceptance stay open. Keep a per-item progress ledger; no completion claim from visible controls or fixture tests.
context: F01-F30 audit found decorative controls, misleading success states and missing owner bridges in the installed desktop baseline.
decision: Fix truth semantics with regression tests; expose Memory low-sensitivity review through a five-minute native-held capability and explicit per-record revision-checked decisions using the existing owner services. Displayed candidate and revision share one owner lock. Never auto-approve user records or expose protected evidence. Add identity-scoped history pagination and encrypted-history scan without a new plaintext search index.
title: Desktop functional repairs and scoped Memory review
